needs_human.note: A read-write bind whose host source does not exist (for example passwords.json bound in the override while the main checkout lacks it) is rewritten into a long-syntax read-only overlay entry with no `bind.create_host_path`. Whether compose keeps the base entry's create_host_path when it merges by target decides between two outcomes: `up` fails with 'bind source path does not exist', or Docker creates a directory outside .r5-stack.; Binds outside the main checkout that a service needs to write (for example a host model cache or a socket directory added in a future override) are now silently made read-only. That service then fails at run time rather than at `clone`.; Non-bind volumes (named volumes, external volumes) are neither redirected nor checked. They are isolated only because the compose project name defaults to the worktree directory name. A COMPOSE_PROJECT_NAME in the symlinked .env, or a top-level `name:`, would make the clone share them, or the containers themselves, with the main stack.; `compose config`, `compose exec` and `compose restart` go through the check and are refused while the overlay fails it, although they start nothing new.
